# xtask test fixtures

Committed, never generated by a test, so no test writes a file (invariant 3).

- `clean/`: a workspace every check passes over. Its crate declares a normal, a dev
  and a build dependency, all approved. It also holds `target/` and `.hidden/`
  sources that break every rule, which the loader must skip.
- `violating/`: a workspace whose `eph-ui` breaks `lints`, `dep-shape`, `no-io` and
  `deps` (an unapproved registry crate, and a path dependency on `outside/`).
- `outside/`: a package outside `violating/`'s workspace.
- `outcomes/`: the report cargo-mutants 27.1.0 writes, at `report/outcomes.json`. A real round reads `mutants.out/outcomes.json`, but cargo-mutants never copies a directory named `mutants.out` into the tree it mutates, so a fixture by that name vanishes from the copy (round 2, 2026-10-19). For the same reason the `target/` junk below is absent in a mutated copy, and the skip rule is tested as a pure predicate instead.

Each fixture holds its own `Cargo.toml`, so the outer workspace's loader treats it
as another package and does not scan it (`xtask/src/workspace.rs`, `rust_files`).
